requirements.title: Graceful Fallback with Clear Messaging
requirements.description: Local-GPU -> Local-CPU -> BYOK-cloud fallback is automatic with explicit user-visible messaging at each transition, including hardware-fit and pre-op BYOK cost estimate.

validation.notes: Fallback chain advances tiers and records the reason
Planned (not yet implemented; automated test pending): BYOK cost estimate shown before a cloud op executes
